receipt.json.title: OpenSim Moco G1 dynamic tracking of the tour driver swing
receipt.json.qualification: Moco direct collocation on the OS-3b scaled tour-marker model; the five metrics under replay_metrics come from one uninterrupted open-loop replay of the fitted controls. Ground reaction is inferred through pelvis residual actuators (no contact model, no force plates); acceptance requires replay_metrics.gates.all_passed, nothing else.
